description: This PHP file defines the 'Payment' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension framework. It manages listing, installing, and uninstalling payment extension modules, including loading related language files, models, permissions, and handling routing URLs.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Controller class for managing payment extensions in the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets the response output to the list of available payment extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads language files, scans extension directory for payment modules, compares installed modules, and prepares data for the payment extensions list view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a payment extension, including permissions, autoload registration, and invoking installation scripts.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for a payment extension, including permission checks and cleanup actions.
